text:
Liam (CEO): Quick heads-up: all-hands Wednesday 11:00am PT, main room. Plan is ~35 minutes. Please drop one question by EOD Tue.

Priya (VP Product): Draft agenda: 1) CEO update (Liam) 2) Product: auto-scaling improvements & customer wins (Priya) 3) Security/policy: retention updates + PII redaction demo (Nora/Elena) 4) Incident highlight and follow-ups (SRE) 5) 10-min open Q&A.

Nora (CTO): Policy teaser: toggling default debug retention to 90 days for hosted accounts; Dedicated customers keep contractual options. We'll demo prompt-redaction in the meeting.

Elena (SRE): Incident summary we'll cover: last Friday's router mapping mismatch caused elevated 5xx in one AZ for ~18 minutes. No data exposure. Root cause and mitigation in #postmortems; quick TL;DR in all-hands.

Ravi (Eng): If anyone wants a 3-min demo slot for new rollout tooling, reply with "demo" + one-line blurb. Upload slides to https://redwood.internal/allhands/upload by Tue 10pm PT.

ops-bot: Reminder: add question by EOD Tue to be read live.

(After meeting)

ops-bot: Recording + slides: https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2467890012-2026-05-14.mp4 | https://redwood.internal/allhands/may-2026.pdf

Liam (CEO): Thanks all. Top takeaways: hiring on infra, shipping predictable latency improvements, policy changes for log retention.

Priya (VP Product): Action items: Eng leads post rollout windows in #eng-releases by Fri; Security publish FAQ by Thu; SRE close postmortem tickets.

Nora (CTO): Thanks for the good questions. If yours wasn't answered live, DM me or Priya and we'll follow up on the thread.

Elena (SRE): Confirmed: customer-facing blurb approved ": No customer data was exposed; the service interruption affected a subset of requests briefly and we have implemented mitigations."

Liam (CEO): Closing: next all-hands in 4 weeks. :wave:
